title: Mount Lavinia Hotel: River Kwai Movie Hotel Guide
description: Stay at the Mount Lavinia Hotel near Colombo, Sri Lanka, where scenes of The Bridge on the River Kwai were filmed. History and visiting tips.
h1: Mount Lavinia Hotel: the Sri Lankan hotel from The Bridge on the River Kwai
intro: Long before it became a beachfront hotel, this building near Colombo was a governor's residence. In 1957 it also took a role in David Lean's Oscar-winning war film.
filming: A number of scenes from The Bridge on the River Kwai (1957) were filmed at the Mount Lavinia Hotel. Film-location guides identify the building as the military hospital seen in the movie. The famous bridge itself was filmed elsewhere in Sri Lanka, not at the hotel.
facts: The building was commissioned in 1806 as a residence for Sir Thomas Maitland, the second governor of British Ceylon.
It has operated continuously as a hotel since 1947.
Today the hotel has 275 rooms and sits at 100 Hotel Road, right on the coast.
The film locations guide notes that the building was known as the Governor's Mansion in colonial times.
visit: Mount Lavinia is a coastal suburb south of central Colombo, so allow time for traffic if you are coming from the city or the airport. Dinner by the sea is a popular way to see the building even if you do not stay.
